overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works held a brief second session in which members voted to deny a damage claim filed by Thomas P. Miller in the amount of $1,519.93, then immediately adjourned. The denial of the claim is the sole substantive action recorded in this portion of the meeting.
committee: City of Wausau Board of Public Works
presiding: Unknown — presiding officer not identified in transcript

discussions.body: A board member moved to deny the claim of Thomas P. Miller in the amount of $1,519.93. The motion was seconded and passed with audible 'aye' votes from those present. No debate or public comment on the claim was recorded in the transcript.
Immediately following the vote on the Miller claim, a member moved to adjourn. The motion was seconded and approved by unanimous voice vote, concluding the meeting.
